sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section questions how kingship can exist before any creature was created, and explains that "Adon Olam" equals Ein Sof, referring to the root of kingship in Atzmus.

translations.translation: “Adon Olam, Who reigned before any creature was created,”
and my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe, precisely analyzes this in his maamar beginning with the words “Zeh”
[in the series beginning “Yom Tov of Rosh HaShanah that falls on Shabbos,”
in which he explains
(in the first maamar)
that the coronation of the king is with great joy],
that it is necessary to understand,
how can kingship exist before any creature was created,
since kingship is specifically over another, as the saying
“There is no king without a nation,”
and furthermore,
kingship is specifically over one who is on his level,
meaning that the nation is similar to the king,
for not only is the concept of kingship
(in a human)
specifically over human beings and not over animals
(for even if a person had thousands of animals, it would not be appropriate for him to be king over them),
but even among human beings themselves, the nation must have some connection and similarity to the king,
as is known
that “nation”
(“There is no king without a nation”)
is from the term “with him,”
so how can the concept of kingship exist before any creature was created?
And he explains this by first citing what is said in the Shelah
(and in several books)
regarding the great praise of “Adon Olam,”
to the point that “Adon Olam” in gematria equals “Ein Sof,”
for the concept of Ein Sof is the most elevated level in Elokus,
and furthermore, it is above the concept of levels,
for the true concept of Ein Sof is
in His Essence.
And based on this, he explains the concept of “Adon Olam Who reigned before any creature was created,”
that since “Adon Olam” is
(in gematria)
Ein Sof,
it is therefore understood
that the concept of “Adon Olam Who reigned…” is the aspect of Malchus as it is rooted, so to speak, in His Essence
(the true concept of Ein Sof),
and since His Essence is all-powerful,
it is possible for Him to be king even without a nation,
before any creature was created.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the shofar service on Rosh HaShanah draws down the will for kingship from Atzmus, which is the root of all mitzvos.

translations.translation: B)
Now, this maamar comes,
as mentioned above,
as a continuation of the maamar beginning “Yom Tov of Rosh HaShanah that falls on Shabbos,”
in which the concept of the shofar blast on Rosh HaShanah is explained at length,
that the service of the shofar blast is a general concept that includes all the particular services of the entire year.
For the concept of the shofar blast is as our Sages said:
“Recite before Me on Rosh HaShanah… Kingship verses, so that you coronate Me over you… and with what? With the shofar.”
And since all the commandments above
(mitzvos)
apply specifically after He becomes King,
as the saying
“Accept My kingship first, and afterward I will decree decrees upon you,”
therefore,
the service of the shofar blast, whose concept is “that you coronate Me over you,” is the root of all mitzvos
(services)
throughout the entire year.
And he explains there,
that the concept of “that you coronate Me over you” through the shofar blast is the drawing down of the will for kingship
(analogous to the coronation of a human king,
which comes with great joy and immense self-nullification to the king,
through which the king is aroused with a will to desire kingship).
And the reason why the service of Yisrael arouses in Him the will for kingship is because even beforehand, He has a will for this,
except that this will is in concealment,
and the service of Yisrael draws the will from concealment to revelation.
And the reason that there is a concealed will for kingship is,
because the concept of the will for kingship exists even beforehand
(before the concealed will),
and it is the absolute will in His Essence.
And in truth, it is not possible to say regarding this that the will for kingship also exists beforehand
(as is said regarding the concealed will,
that even before it is aroused in revealed will, the will already exists in concealment),
for in His Essence, it is not applicable to say that there is some concept that is in concealment,
and everything there is in the aspect of absolute unity in the utmost simplicity.
And the concept of “that you coronate Me over you” through the shofar blast is not only to draw the will for kingship from concealment to revelation,
from the aspect of the will as it is included in concealment in the Ein Sof before the tzimtzum
(in the aspect of revelation to Himself),
but rather,
that through this, there is also drawn from the absolute will in His Essence,
for this will is, so to speak, the very Essence
(and it is not applicable to say of it that it is included in concealment).
And this drawing down on Rosh HaShanah is through “that you coronate Me over you,”
a will for kingship,
and from this is subsequently drawn the will for mitzvos
(decrees),
for the main concept of mitzvos is the will above.
And as explained in many places,
that the reason the fulfillment of mitzvos must be specifically with particularity and precision
(as we were commanded),
is,
because regarding the will, it matters that every particular be exactly as the will dictates.
